surfaces.label: Public Ingress exposure of Ollama and Open WebUI
Ollama HTTP adapter (pull/create/list via internal service)
surfaces.notes: Client connects only to the workspace's own internal Ollama service; model/pattern values are used by design (system prompts / model names). No SSRF to arbitrary hosts.

surfaces.label: ExecuteRemoteCommand (pod exec /bin/sh -c)
surfaces.notes: Command string is a hardcoded constant (du -sh <mount>) today; latent command-exec primitive noted for future features.

surfaces.label: Modelfile / system-prompt template generation
surfaces.notes: Patterns/model names are interpolated into Ollama modelfiles by design (the product feature); embedded data is static (go:embed). No code execution or traversal.

surfaces.label: Operator RBAC breadth (verbs=* on core + networking resources)
surfaces.notes: Operator SA has very broad RBAC incl. pods/exec; large blast radius if the operator is compromised, but not directly attacker-reachable. See report notes.

surfaces.label: Secrets / credential handling
surfaces.notes: No hardcoded credentials; workload pods set automountServiceAccountToken=false; metrics endpoint uses authn/authz filters when secure.

surfaces.label: Config retrieval from ConfigMap
surfaces.notes: Reads operator config from a fixed system-namespace ConfigMap; not attacker-controlled.
